§6Pre-Mortem · how does this trade fail?
5 numbered failure modes ranked by likelihood · write it BEFORE entry, not after
P(failure) 22-38% by mode
1
False breakout · fade back into base
PROBABILITY · 22%
Spot reverses below 52w-high pivot · re-enters 6-week base · stop hit at $404.66. Most common failure for breakout-expansion setups.
2
52w-high exhaustion · supply cap
PROBABILITY · 20%
Institutional supply at $442 caps the breakout · sideways drift · time-stop exit at small profit or breakeven.
3
Sector rotation · semis lose RS lead
PROBABILITY · 15%
Sector RS rank drops below 70 · AVGO follows the cohort · L5 invalidation triggers regardless of price level.
4
Macro shock · VIX > 22 risk-off
PROBABILITY · 12%
FOMC 6/18 or geopolitics drives VIX above choppy band · β 1.44 amplifies drawdown · L1 stop hit on the way down.
5
Tail-loss event repeats
PROBABILITY · 10%
Same pattern that triggered tail-loss demotion (stars=3 kill set) recurs · price gaps below stop · slippage exceeds modeled 30bp.
